content:
incident-bot: ALERT: 5xx spike detected on prod-gateway (TLS handshake failures). 3.8% 5xx over last 5m, errors predominantly handshake failures. PagerDuty triggered.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: oncall Priya K paged. Incident created INC-2026-423. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-423

Priya K: I'm on it. Seeing spike in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Graph: https://grafana.redwood/prod-gateway/errors (5m window).

Matt S: Joining. Any recent cert rotations or deploys?

ops-rotator-bot: Certificate rotation job completed 2026-03-15T01:02Z for internal-mtls. New intermediate CN=redwood-int-v2, root unchanged. Rollout status: reported success.

Samir I: Logs show a lot of upstream "SSL: certificate verify failed" in proxy. Sample: 
[2026-03-15T01:08:12Z] gw-eu-7 proxy_conn: TLS alert 48 handshake failure from 10.2.5.11

Lina R: runtime metrics: handshake_timeouts up + model-router shows increased backend connection errors. Looks like mTLS verification failing between gateway and backend.

Raj P: Quick debug: openssl s_client -connect backend-eu-11:443 -showcerts returns: 
"verify error:num=20:self signed certificate in certificate chain" then "tlsv1 alert unknown ca". Suggests truststore mismatch.

Hannah G: Support: two paying customers reported 502s with "upstream TLS error". IDs cust-203, cust-998. Notifying them we're investigating.

Eli J: Product: high customer impact. Need mitigation that avoids full downtime — prefer routing/workarounds.

Priya K: Short-term plan: 1) Route traffic away from affected hosts/pools. 2) Hot-update truststore on gateways still trusting old CA. 3) If needed, enable temporary non-mTLS path for affected backends. Who can update truststores?

Samir I: I'll push temporary truststore update to gateways in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Will coordinate with Lina for traffic steering.

Lina R: Confirmed: backend certs for some replicas are served with the old intermediate chain (fingerprint ab:cd:ef:12). Our gateways were updated to trust the new intermediate; mismatch causes verification fail.

Matt S: Why are some replicas still serving old chain if ops-rotator reported success? Could be cached certs in sidecars not reloaded.

ops-rotator-bot: Rollout status detail: 98% success. 12 hosts reporting old-chain: gw-eu-3, gw-eu-7, router-us-9, backend-eu-11, backend-eu-12, sidecar-us-4, sidecar-eu-5, gw-us-2, router-eu-6, backend-us-8, gw-eu-9, router-us-11.

Priya K: Ok. Mitigation steps: Samir update truststore on listed gateways first, then Lina will canary route traffic. Samir, can you hot-reload?

Samir I: Pushing to gw-eu-3 now: 
```
ansible-playbook playbooks/update_truststore.yml -l gw-eu-3 --extra-vars "bundle=/etc/ssl/redwood/bundles/new-intermediate.pem"
```
We'll graceful reload to avoid connection drops.

Priya K: Good. Avoid restarts if possible.

ops-rotator-bot: host gw-eu-3 truststore updated; envoy reload succeeded.

Lina R: Shifting 5% of affected customer traffic to gw-eu-3 canary. Monitoring: error rate for those sessions dropped 7.1% -> 0.9%. Latency stable.

Matt S: Excellent. Continue rollout.

Samir I: Pushed to gw-eu-7 and gw-eu-9; reload OK. Pushing to router-us-9 now.

Hannah G: Support message to customers drafted: "We're aware of intermittent TLS handshake failures affecting API requests for some regions. Engineers are applying fixes; we expect recovery within 15-30 minutes. No data loss. We'll update you shortly." Approve?

Eli J: Approve. Send.

Raj P: Root cause hypothesis: concurrent CA/intermediate rotation + partial rollout + cached certs in sidecars leading to mismatched chain validation. Immediate remediation: ensure truststore accepts old chain temporarily OR finish rollout consistently. Longer term: require sidecar cert cache flush and pre-rotation consistency checks.

Priya K: Lina, increase canary to 25% then 100% if metrics look good. Samir continue truststore updates on remaining hosts.

Lina R: 25% -> metrics stable. 100% -> global error rate back to baseline ~0.2%.

Matt S: Creating incident doc INC-2026-423/notes and will attach logs: edge TLS alerts, openssl outputs, ops-rotator audit.

Hannah G: Sent customer update. No escalations so far.

ops-rotator-bot: Incident marked resolved by Priya K at 1719005400. Duration 6m40s.

Priya K: Closing thread. Postmortem owners: Samir I (ops) — investigate rollout edgecases; Raj P (security) — rotation/process changes; Lina R (telemetry) — add alerts for cert-chain mismatches. Follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-16 10:00 UTC. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
